282043487.description:
Estate Smoking Pipe Collection With Wooden Display Stand
Lot of 6 Briar Wood Tobacco Pipes
Mid-to-Late 20th Century
This vintage estate collection features six classic smoking pipes crafted primarily from briar wood, accompanied by a traditional two-tiered wooden pipe rack. The rack includes designated slots for pipe storage alongside a recessed circular tray intended for a tobacco jar or humidor. Representing popular mid-century bowl shapes including billiard and Dublin variations, this ensemble reflects the mid-to-late 20th-century era of traditional pipe smoking culture.
Lot includes six estate tobacco pipes and one wooden pipe display rack
Five smooth briar wood pipes and one dark rusticated carved finish pipe
Classic vulcanite stems with various shapes and profile inlays
Solid wood stand features multi-pipe capacity with an integrated round accessory basin
Condition:
Pre-owned estate condition. Bowls exhibit interior carbon cake buildup, rim darkening, and surface finish wear consistent with age and use. Stems show heavy oxidation, discoloration, and visible tooth chatter or bite wear. One pipe shank features a visible split along the mortise. Wooden rack displays surface scratches, scuffs, and finish wear, particularly within the round base cutout.
